{{Top|leg}}
'''Myogens''' were [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] mutations that grew on a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Koros-Strohna]] when it reached an old age. These growths illuminated the halls and passageways of the ship. It was one of two signs of aging in these ships, another being unusual coloring on the [[dovin basal]]s.
